        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  interval: z.number().int().positive('Interval must be a positive integer').default(60),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  verifyAuth(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method || 'GET',\n    interval: body.interval || 60, // Default 60 seconds\n    tags: body.tags,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Overview\n\nThis is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.\n\n## NPM package manager\n\nShould be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.\n\n## How to use Nuxthub?\n\nNuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.\n\n### Database\n\n- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.\n- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.\n- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes\n- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory\n- **Workflow**:\n  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory\n  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration\n  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development\n- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.\n- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "alwaysApply: true",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "# Overview",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "This is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## NPM package manager",
            "lineNumber": 8

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "Should be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "## How to use Nuxthub?",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Nuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.",
            "lineNumber": 14

          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "### Database",
            "lineNumber": 16

          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.",

          {
            "text": "- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes",
            "lineNumber": 20

            "text": "- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory",

        "contents": "import { desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * GET /monitors/:id/logs\n * Get logs for a specific monitor (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  verifyAuth(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Monitor not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Get query parameters for pagination\n  const query = getQuery(event)\n  const limit = query.limit ? Number.parseInt(query.limit as string, 10) : 100\n  const offset = query.offset ? Number.parseInt(query.offset as string, 10) : 0\n\n  // Get logs for this monitor, ordered by created_at descending\n  const monitorLogs = await db\n    .select()\n    .from(schema.serviceLogs)\n    .where(eq(schema.serviceLogs.serviceId, serviceId))\n    .orderBy(desc(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp))\n    .limit(limit)\n    .offset(offset)\n\n  return {\n    serviceId,\n    logs: monitorLogs,\n    total: monitorLogs.length,\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "/* eslint-disable node/prefer-global/process */\nimport type { H3Event } from 'h3'\n\n/**\n * Verify Bearer token authentication\n * Format: \"Bearer PASSWORD\"\n */\nexport function verifyAuth(event: H3Event): boolean {\n  const authHeader = getHeader(event, 'authorization')\n\n  if (!authHeader) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 401,\n      statusMessage: 'Unauthorized',\n      message: 'Missing Authorization header',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const [authType, password] = authHeader.split(' ')\n\n  if (authType !== 'Bearer' || !password) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 401,\n      statusMessage: 'Unauthorized',\n      message: 'Invalid Authorization header format. Expected: Bearer PASSWORD',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Get password from environment variable\n  const validPassword = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'admin'\n\n  if (password !== validPassword) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 403,\n      statusMessage: 'Forbidden',\n      message: 'Invalid password',\n    })\n  }\n\n  return true\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {

            "line": 50,
            "column": 2

        "contents": "import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * DELETE /monitors/:id\n * Delete monitor (authentication required)\n * Related logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade delete\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  verifyAuth(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Service not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Delete service (logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade)\n  await db.delete(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId))\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n    message: 'Monitor deleted successfully',\n  }\n})",
